title: Draw the explanation
when: The speaker explains an idea that can be drawn.
story: Pose the question, construct a visual explanation, stress-test it, then leave the useful model.
picture: An evolving hand-drawn diagram with labels that arrive when named.
pace: Follow the actual thought; alternate construction with time to inspect.
rules: Keep narration and timing when replacing imported kinetic beats with drawings.
Draw new objects for the subject rather than recycling unrelated stock metaphors.
